titre: Write the system down before plugging in the agent
essentiel: Design MD, context.md, written wireframes: the text file comes before the MCP and gets the prototype right faster.
Accessibility moves into tokens (Mzizi, Vallaure) and comes back to the designer as measured options.
Faced with the Figma MCP quota, designers work around it: a plugin coded by Claude, third-party MCPs, an MCP shipped with the design system.

syntheses.titre: The text file comes before the MCP server
syntheses.texte: Headway starts teams with a single Design MD and keeps the MCP for later. Jeremy Johnson now spends 80% of his time on a plain-text spec and his prototype lands on the first try. Altay Suna goes as far as designing a whole website in readable files, with no design tool. Abha M confirms it on a small scale: a 4-page brief beats a one-line prompt.

syntheses.titre: Accessibility is coded into tokens, the decision stays with the designer
syntheses.texte: Project Mzizi bakes its minimums (17px, 49px targets, 7:1 contrast) into tokens and serves them to agents over MCP. Christine Vallaure starts from contrast checks in code and has Claude lay out measured options on the canvas, with an explicit ban on changing tokens. Both share one prerequisite: same tokens, same names, in code and in Figma, which Sakani UI also promises.

syntheses.titre: AI provides a better start, not the judgment
syntheses.texte: Pavle Lucic claims designers "don't need to learn design anymore" and gets 96 anxious comments. Abha M and Sarim Khan answer from experience: AI writes the code and the screens, but choosing between two patterns or a layout stays with the designer. The debate is no longer about the tool, but about what the designer keeps.

syntheses.titre: When the Figma MCP blocks, code takes over
syntheses.texte: Humza Mehmood hits the Figma MCP quota and has Claude write a plugin that generates the whole design system. Christine Vallaure uses a third-party MCP (Console MCP), and Sakani UI ships its own MCP and agent skill. The official MCP is no longer the only way into the file.

posts.role: Founder of moonlearning.io, trains designers in Figma and AI design system workflows, 2x Config speaker
posts.idee: The accessibility report becomes a designer's decision. Contrast checks run in code; through MCP, Claude sorts failures (design, dev, joint) and lays out on the Figma canvas today's state plus two measured options, without touching tokens.
concret: Console MCP (Southleft) to read and write the open Figma file
Dark-mode badges and alerts: 7/7 failing today, option A 3/7, option B 7/7 passing by re-aliasing semantic tokens to a darker primitive already in the palette
Under each option, the exact tokens that change, ready for developers
Prompt includes: "Do not change any tokens"
Prerequisite: Figma library generated from code, same token names on both sides
posts.commentaires: She stresses it is neither an audit nor a replacement for testing with real people.

posts.role: Product agency coaching teams on Claude Code and design system MCPs
posts.idee: Design MD first, MCP later. For a team with no developers starting Claude Code, one file (colors, brand standards, component definitions) is enough to get on-brand screens; the MCP server comes once the team shares the design system's tech stack.
concret: One Design MD file: colors, brand rules, component definitions
Same file for designers without repo access: rebuild components in Claude Design or a Figma Make kit
"Design System MCPs" session by Billy Sweetman and Tim Gremore, slides in the comments
posts.commentaires: The full presentation is shared in the comments.

posts.role: Design leader with 20 years' experience, leads a UX team on AI experiences for industrial AI
posts.idee: The leverage in AI prototyping is the text written before it. He went from 20% prompting and 80% fixing to 80% plain-text specification upfront: the prototype lands on the first or second try.
concret: 5-phase loop: Research, Explore, Gather, Build, Share
"Words before pixels": explore directions in text before UI
A context.md file gathering customer evidence, patterns and internal data
Screen-by-screen text walkthrough, then a targeted build
Dedicated prompt cards per phase; outputs: deck, video, PRD

Written wireframes instead of drawn ones

posts.role: Open research from the Bundu Foundation: a language, toolchain and component registry for agents and people
posts.idee: Accessibility minimums live in the tokens. Text size, touch targets, contrast and minimum spacing are set by default, checked from the command line, taught in agent skills and served by a free MCP.
concret: 17px body text, 14px captions
49px touch targets
7:1 text contrast, designed for outdoors and cheap phones
A spacing floor
Docs that separate what is built, only designed, or still to prove

posts.idee: A detailed brief beats a one-line prompt, but judgment is missing. In Claude Design, a 4–5 page role-based prompt gives a better-aligned result, even better with a design system built via Claude Code and Figma MCP; pattern choices still need review.
concret: One-line prompt vs 4–5 page brief
Design system built with Claude Code and Figma MCP
Example of a choice to review: radio buttons vs chevrons depending on complexity

posts.idee: "Designers don't need to learn design anymore." A deliberately provocative post: watching AI edit his real Figma files through MCP excites him as much as it scares him.
concret: Observation: AI creating layouts and editing components via MCP

posts.commentaires: 96 comments: the debate pits knowing how to prompt against knowing how to judge, a sign of real anxiety in the profession.
